text:
Maya Patel: Quick check — we're locking down Q2 spot awards distribution across US / EU / APAC. Need approvals flow, tax/payout method, and any vendor lead times. Can folks chime in by EOD Thu?
Ethan Cruz: Thanks Maya — can you drop budget left + target count?
Maya Patel: Sure — rough numbers below:
```
Budget remaining: $12,500
Planned recipients: 28
Breakdown: US 14 | EU 8 | APAC 6
Average award size target: $350
```
Luca Moretti: Payroll can handle US awards (taxed on paycheck). For EU/APAC payroll varies — some countries require grossing up / reporting. If we do gift cards, those often need vendor invoices and local tax filings.
Samira Chen: From finance POV, payroll is cleaner for US and UK. For EU non-UK it's messy unless we use local vendors. We have $1,200 vendor budget left after reserving payroll fees.
Ava Nguyen: Also thinking about physical thank-you postcards for offices (small hand-signed notes). Local print vendors will need ~10 business days. For remote recipients we can include a voucher email.
Maya Patel: Good call on timelines. So action items: decide payment channel per region, confirm vendor, collect approver list by Fri.
SpotAwardsBot: Reminder — nomination window closes Wed 17:00 PT. Please confirm final list within 48h after that.
Luca Moretti: Quick checklist so we don't miss compliance:
- US: payroll OK (send W-9s if external vendor)
- EU: prefer vendor payouts; need invoice + local tax ID in some countries
- APAC: country-by-country; Singapore/India have payroll options but filing differs
Can ops compile per-recipient country?
Maya Patel: I'll export nominations with country column this afternoon and share in the drive.
Ethan Cruz: On approvals — I can approve up to $5k vendor spend; anything above needs Samira sign-off.
Samira Chen: Correct. If we route >$5k to a single vendor, I need a short SOV and cost breakdown.
Ava Nguyen: For physical cards: can we use the same vendor across EU offices to save on setup? I can get 2 quotes by Tue.
Luca Moretti: If going vendor route for EU, include VAT invoices and confirm whether vendor will ship customs-ready. Some BR/IN shipments need extra paperwork.
Maya Patel: Noted. One more thing — for managers who want to top-up awards, do we let them add funds and route to payroll, or should they send reimbursements to finance?
Ethan Cruz: Managers topping up should go through finance reimbursement flow — easier for tracking.
Maya Patel: Great. I'll compile a final doc with per-region recommended channels and vendor recs, post early Fri. @Ethan @Samira please scan for approvals. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
Samira Chen: Will review Friday morning.
Ethan Cruz: I'll sign off if numbers match.
SpotAwardsBot: Thread activity logged. Nomination deadline in 48 hours.
